title: Metadata review center
subtitle: Resolve pending, low-confidence, and failed identifications in one place. Review the virtual-path diff before metadata and file mappings are updated atomically.

recent.title: Recent remaps
recent.subtitle: Undo a recent atomic remap here, provided no later edit has replaced it.
recent.empty: Undoable remaps will appear here after you complete a review.

editor.title: Review metadata
editor.unsetHint: Leave a field blank to clear it. Changing any input after previewing invalidates that preview.

validation.tmdbId: Enter a valid positive-integer TMDB ID.
validation.nonNegativeInteger: Enter a whole number greater than or equal to 0.
validation.groupNameLength: Release group must be 200 characters or fewer.

errors.conflict: This item changed elsewhere. Close the panel, refresh the list, and review it again (409).
errors.validation: The server could not validate this metadata or its paths. Check the input and warnings, then retry (422).
errors.requestFailed: The request failed and no changes were applied. Please try again.

preview.title: Pre-apply preview
preview.noPathChanges: This item has no files to remap; its metadata can still be updated from this preview.
preview.collisionAdjusted: A path collision was detected, so the server adjusted the destination filename.

warningCodes.notDownloaded: The download is incomplete, so only metadata will change and existing file mappings will be preserved.
warningCodes.unresolvedFiles: Some files could not be identified and will use the unknown-file virtual-path rule.

toast.undoConflict: Cannot undo: this item has a newer update (409)
toast.undoValidation: Cannot undo: the former paths cannot be restored (422)

pending.title: Awaiting identification
pending.emptyBody: Every new item is identified or has moved to another review category.

lowConfidence.title: Low-confidence results
lowConfidence.emptyBody: There are no low-confidence identifications awaiting confirmation.

failed.title: Failed identifications
failed.emptyBody: There are no failed identifications or items at their retry limit.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the review queue
errors.loadFailedDetail: The latest review state is unavailable. Check the service connection and retry.

rules.title: Recognition rules
rules.subtitle: Save a confirmed correction separately as a reusable rule for future releases. Every supplied matching condition must be satisfied.
rules.undoHint: Undo restores one correction. Disabling a rule stops future recognition and leaves previous corrections and results intact.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.patternHint: Enter a .NET regex manually; (?<episode>\d+) and (?<season>\d+) can capture numbers. Example: \[Example\].* - (?<episode>\d+)\b. AI supplies missing metadata; existing filename regex rules remain separate.
rules.scopeHint: Restrict source, title, or group. Blank season/group values retain inferred metadata. The offset is added to the captured or inferred episode. Saving or enabling applies automatically only to releases ingested after the effective time.
rules.saved: Rule saved. Existing records are unchanged; preview and confirm historical items individually.
rules.previewHint: Read-only examples from existing records, showing up to 50 matches, not a forecast of future releases. Save the rule to preview path changes for individual historical items.
rules.truncated: Scanning is limited to the latest 1000 records matching the source restriction.
rules.hitsHint: Names and revisions are retained as they were when recognition ran. Later edits and individual corrections do not rewrite this history.

warnings.conflict: Conflicts with another enabled rule; manual review required.
warnings.ambiguous: Season/episode matching or offset is ambiguous; manual review required.
warnings.needsInference: No season is available. Identify this item first.

errors.requestFailed: Rule request failed. Refresh and try again.
errors.ruleName: Enter a rule name of up to 200 characters.
errors.ruleScope: Restrict subscription source, title pattern, or subtitle group.
errors.ruleLength: Patterns allow 1000 characters; group names allow 200.
errors.rulePattern: Invalid, empty-matching, or timed-out regex. Narrow the pattern.
errors.ruleNumbers: Season must be non-negative; offset must be between -10000 and 10000.
errors.ruleSource: The subscription source no longer exists. Select another.
errors.ruleCorrection: Complete the individual correction before creating its rule.
errors.ruleNotFound: The rule no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.ruleChanged: The rule changed. Reload and preview it again.
errors.ruleConflict: Matching changed or conflicts with another rule. Preview again.
errors.ruleAmbiguous: Matching is ambiguous. Adjust the rule or correct the item manually.
errors.ruleLimit: Up to 200 rules are supported. Edit an existing rule.
